evidence.title: GitHub - google-labs-code/stitch-skills: A library of Agent Skills designed to work with the Stitch MCP server. Each skill follows the Agent Skills open standard, for compatibility with coding agents…

name: shadcn-ui
summary: Agent skill for discovering, installing and customizing shadcn/ui components and blocks in a project.
description: A SKILL.md skill from Google's Stitch skills library that walks an agent through shadcn/ui: browsing and adding components (50+ buttons, dialogs, forms, tables …), theming via CSS variables, class-variance-authority variants, composition patterns, and blocks such as authentication forms, dashboards and sidebars. It states the requirements (React 18+, Tailwind CSS 3.0+, npx shadcn@latest add) and uses MCP tools to discover, retrieve and install components.
contains: 50+ accessible components on Radix UI or Base UI primitives
theming via CSS variables; variants with class-variance-authority
blocks for authentication forms, dashboards and sidebars
MCP tools to discover, retrieve and install components
